# VEXARO SMM Panel — Full Knowledge Base & AI Context File (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
VEXARO SMM (https://vexarosmm.com) is Pakistan's premier wholesale Social Media Marketing (SMM) provider platform. Designed for marketing agencies, content creators, resellers, e-commerce brands, and digital entrepreneurs, VEXARO automates the delivery of social signals (followers, likes, views, watch time, subscribers, reactions, and traffic) across all major global platforms.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Direct Primary Server Routing**: Orders are processed through automated low-latency provider APIs, bypassing expensive reseller markups.
- **Wholesale Pricing**: Services start as low as ₨1.85 / 1,000 views, enabling agencies to resell at 300% to 700% profit margins.
- **Local Banking Without Transaction Fees**: 0% deduction deposits via SadaPay (03197008275), Easypaisa, and JazzCash.
- **Global Crypto Payments**: Instant automated Binance Pay and USDT (TRC-20 & BEP-20) wallet funding.
- **Automated Refill Protection**: 30-day and 60-day automated refill coverage replaces natural platform drops.
- **Data Privacy & Account Safety**: No social media account passwords, tokens, or email logins are ever requested or stored.

## Developer & Reseller REST API Specification
- **API Endpoint**: https://vexarosmm.com/api/v2
- **Protocol**: Standard SMM v2 (POST / JSON & x-www-form-urlencoded)
- **Supported Actions**:
  - `services`: List all available services with min/max, rates, and refill statuses.
  - `add`: Place an automated order with `service`, `link`, `quantity`.
  - `status`: Check order status (`Pending`, `In progress`, `Completed`, `Partial`, `Canceled`), start count, and remains.
  - `multiStatus`: Check statuses for multiple order IDs simultaneously.
  - `balance`: Real-time account balance query in PKR and USD.
  - `refill`: Trigger refill on eligible completed orders.
